annotations.title: Subscribe to sports tech job alerts

description: Sign an email address up for Jobs in Sports Tech job alert emails, optionally with preferred regions and job functions. Use only with the user's own email address, given by the user for this purpose. The address is stored with the stated preferences only; every email includes an unsubscribe link. Returns a preview of recent roles matching those preferences.
